item.title: Version 1.3.12
item.description:
• Fix screen capture after connecting an external monitor by refreshing ScreenCaptureKit display/window state before capture.
  • Capture full-screen from the display under the pointer when multiple monitors are connected.
  • Normalize selection overlays to local screen bounds so area and window capture target external displays correctly.

item.title: Version 1.3.11
item.description:
• Fix area screenshots on external monitors by clamping selected regions to the captured display before cropping.
  • Share screen-coordinate conversion across screenshot, recording, window selection, and translation overlay paths.

item.title: Version 1.3.10
item.description:
• Restore the Captr logo in the menu bar instead of the generic plus icon.
  • Request and verify screen capture permission before all screenshot modes.
  • Add system audio usage text and the audio input entitlement for recording permissions.

item.title: Version 1.3.9
item.description:
• Restore bundled app resources so release builds include the app icon and asset catalog.
  • Avoid blocking releases on DMG notarization after the app is already notarized and stapled.

item.title: Version 1.3.7
item.description: • Fix window screenshots and recordings with hover-to-select window targeting.\n- Fix annotation saving so drawn markup is included in exported screenshots.\n- Improve area capture, window capture, and device mirroring reliability.\n- Avoid unsupported iOS recording flows and unexpected microphone permission prompts.

item.title: Version 1.3.6
item.description: • Fix area screenshots showing the desktop wallpaper instead of Captr's own windows. v1.3.4's filter excluded every Captr window from area captures; the overlay-hiding the filter was guarding against is already handled by alphaValue=0 + orderOut + CATransaction.flush + a 150 ms sleep before capture.

item.title: Version 1.3.5
item.description: Fix screen recording producing zero-byte files on macOS 26: the previous fix tried to strip ScreenCaptureKit's stereoscopic-disparity attachment off each frame, but the tag lives on the upstream IOSurface and can't be removed via CVBuffer or IOSurface APIs. AVAssetWriter then rejected every frame with err -16122 ("operation could not be completed"). Maintain a pixel-buffer pool, deep-copy each frame into a clean buffer, and append the copy instead. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.4
item.description: - Fix screen recording failing with "operation could not be completed" on macOS 26: ScreenCaptureKit attaches a stereoscopic-disparity tag to every frame that AVAssetWriter rejects when encoding plain H.264 — strip it before append. Pin source/output color to Rec.709/sRGB so they agree on extended-gamut displays. - Fix area recording on a non-primary monitor: pick the display containing the selected area, and translate the area to display-local coords before assigning to sourceRect. - Keep the area-selection overlay out of area screenshots: prime the SCRunningApplication for our own bundle and exclude it from the capture filter; force the overlay window to vanish before the capture pipeline reads back. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.3
item.description: - "Check for Updates…" menu item now shows a spinner and "Checking for updates…" while Sparkle is contacting the server, so it's clear something is happening when the appcast fetch is slow. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.2
item.description: - Area screenshot to clipboard and OCR/translation paths now use ScreenCaptureKit's SCScreenshotManager instead of the deprecated CGWindowListCreateImage. macOS 15 was nagging users to re-grant Screen Recording permission once a month for any app still on the legacy API; the modern API doesn't trigger the prompt. - Recording errors are no longer silent: when a recording produces an empty file (e.g. permission missing, no frames received, asset writer error) the menu bar now surfaces the actual reason instead of the overlay just disappearing. - Removed Utilities/CGWindowCapture.h/.m and the now-empty bridging header reference. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description: - Re-cut v1.3.0 to push the appcast forward — auto-update users were stuck on v1.2.6 because the previous release didn't refresh appcast.xml - In-place translation overlay replaces the popup: translated text is composited onto the captured screenshot at the exact screen coordinates you dragged - Movable overlay with Save, Copy, and Close toolbar buttons; Cmd+S saves to the screenshots library, Cmd+C copies the composite, Esc dismisses - Claude API translation engine as an alternative to Apple's on-device translator (segments batched into one Messages API call for speed) - Settings → Translation panel for picking the engine and storing an Anthropic API key in the Keychain Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description: - In-place translation overlay replaces the popup: translated text is composited onto the captured screenshot and shown at the exact screen coordinates you dragged, with original text masked behind a sampled background color - Movable overlay with Save, Copy, and Close toolbar buttons; Cmd+S saves to the screenshots library, Cmd+C copies the composite, Esc dismisses - Claude API translation engine as an alternative to Apple's on-device translator (segments batched into one Messages API call for speed) - Settings → Translation panel for picking the engine and storing an Anthropic API key in the Keychain Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)
